title: Map curiosities, round 3 A: the Tesla Tower, the Moon Gun, the Gold Claim and the Lost Expedition as tile overlays, their legend icons, and the Tesla arc, Moon Gun blast and Expedition notes effects

Keep the dark iron barrel, the bronze bands, the stone mount, the smoke puff, the outline and the art style exactly the same.

Erase everything except the khaki tent, the crates, the pith helmet, the rolled map and the journal: remove the green grass and the brown soil block under them completely, so the camp stands directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under it. Keep the tent, the crates, the helmet, the map, the journal, the outline and the art style exactly the same.
